label: Curved Cuff — 1 Button, 1 Buttonhole
description: The curved one-button cuff is a barrel cuff whose outer corners are rounded off rather than left square, fastened with a single button and one buttonhole. The softened corners give the wrist a gentler, more refined silhouette than a sharp squared cuff while keeping the simplicity of a single-button closure. It is a subtle, slightly dressier take on the everyday barrel cuff.
